title: 24 August 1961: Live: St John's Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ ninth performance at St John’s Hall on Snaefell Avenue in Tuebrook, Liverpool.

Mona Best, mother of Pete and owner of the Casbah Coffee Club, also ran some nights at St John’s Hall. The venue shouldn’t be confused with a hall in Bootle of the same name where The Beatles also performed.

The Beatles played at Liverpool’s St John’s Hall on 11 occasions. The other dates were 17 February; 10 March; 13, 20 and 27 July; 3, 10, 17 and 31 August; and 8 September 1961.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1973: Mixing: Meat City by John Lennon
  • 1972: Wings live: Deutschlandhalle, Berlin
  • 1971: Recording, mixing: Mind Train, Midsummer New York, Don’t Count The Waves by Yoko Ono
  • 1968: Television: John Lennon and Yoko Ono on Frost On Saturday
  • 1967: The Beatles meet Maharishi Mahesh Yogi
  • 1966: Day off in Los Angeles
  • 1965: The Beatles take LSD in Los Angeles with The Byrds and Peter Fonda
  • 1964: Day off in Bel Air, Los Angeles
  • 1964: US single release: Matchbox
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Gaumont Cinema, Bournemouth
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Majestic Ballroom, Birkenhead
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
  • 1960: The Beatles live: Indra Club, Hamburg
